handTotalHelp: Declare Yaniv when your hand total is 5 or less; any excess becomes penalty points.

label.selectCard: Select cards to discard (single / set / run)

pickup.hint: You can only take a card from either end of the discard.
pickup.disabledReason: Middle cards can't be taken (only the two ends)

discardWarn.pair: To discard two cards they must be a same-rank set.
discardWarn.joker: A joker can only be discarded on its own.
discardWarn.general: You may only discard a single card, a same-rank set, or a same-suit run of 3+.

hint.declareYaniv: Your hand total is 5 or less — declare Yaniv!
hint.discardHigh: Discard your highest cards to lower your hand total
hint.takePickup: Take the low card from the discard to keep your total down

tutorial.cpuArea: Your opponents. Their penalty totals are shown; hands are revealed at round end.
tutorial.discardArea: The stock and the last discard. You may take either end of the previous discard.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Keep the total low — discard high cards or matching sets and runs.
tutorial.actionButtons: Discard, then draw. When your hand total is 5 or less, call Yaniv to end the round.
